metadata.description: Give Claude a video input. /watch downloads, extracts frames, transcribes, and hands it all to Claude. Fork of bradautomates/claude-video by Bradley Bonanno (MIT), with fixes for ffmpeg 8+ where -vsync was removed.

owner.name: Robin Jose (fork of Bradley Bonanno's claude-video)

plugins.name: watch
plugins.description: Watch a video (URL or local path). Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts frames with ffmpeg, transcribes via captions or Whisper.
